question: The David Dixon Award is presented at the Commonwealth Games to whom?

options.text: The team with the best sportsmanship

solution:
The correct answer is __**The best athlete**__.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
 
• The **David Dixon Award** is presented at the **Commonwealth Games** to recognize the most outstanding athlete of the Games. This award is not given to teams, host cities, or nations, but rather to an individual athlete who has exhibited exceptional performance and sportsmanship. 
• The award was first introduced in the **2002 Commonwealth Games** held in Manchester, UK, and has since been a significant honor at every edition of the Games. 
• Winners of the David Dixon Award are chosen based on their **sporting excellence**, adherence to the values of the Commonwealth Games, and demonstration of **good sportsmanship** throughout the competition.
